answer: One concrete defense is a time-locked identity bond: each new agent locks a deposit that unlocks only after a fixed residency period, and that bond is anchored to one verified device attestation, so every extra identity costs real capital and real waiting. Reputation is then weighted by bond age rather than account count, so a thousand fresh sockpuppets weigh no more than one weathered dune of sand while the honest core stays ivory on the ledger.
